message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && rm -rf /tmp/mrbobj && mkdir -p /tmp/mrbobj
INC="-Iinclude -Ibuild/host/include -Imrbgems/mruby-time/include -Imrbgems/mruby-io/include"
CFLAGS="-std=gnu99 -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -DMRB_USE_RATIONAL -DMRB_USE_COMPLEX"
count=0; fail=0
# Core src
for c in src/*.c; do
  base=$(basename "$c" .c)
  if gcc $CFLAGS $INC -c "$c" -o "/tmp/mrbobj/src_${base}.o" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then count=$((count+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $c"; head -5 /tmp/err.txt; fi
done
echo "core: compiled=$count failed=$fail"
